title: Train for Truth, Keep the Skills: Binary Retrieval-Augmented Reward Mitigates Hallucinations
authors: Tong Chen; Akari Asai; Luke Zettlemoyer; Hannaneh Hajishirzi; Faeze Brahman
why_relevant: Proposes RL with binary retrieval-augmented reward to reduce hallucinations and induce calibrated abstention (IDK), directly relevant to calibration/control and abstention behavior in RAG-related factuality training.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on post-training factuality rather than RAG inference robustness; retrieval is used for reward verification, not as the system's evidence pipeline.
